  Scenario: AC9 The write-off row, its state and its approved amount are declared on write_off only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the write_off element of the baseline

    Then the row, its state and its approved amount are declared on the write_off element only, and no other element declares them

  Scenario: AC10 The posted population is declared as ACE data read by rwb-source-data with no gl_write_off or v_ace_write_off property (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the posting product of the baseline
    When the consumed rows are compared with rwb-source-data, DP-01 and DP-05
    Then the posting product is declared as consumed, and the document declares no gl_write_off property, no v_ace_write_off property and no view of its own (ASM-5084)

  Scenario: AC11 The comparison is count and amount inside the tolerance in force, with the tolerance and the period held as package values (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the comparison section of the baseline
    When it is compared with REC-06, R-WO-42, R-WO-43 and BR-S7-011
    Then the comparison is declared as count and amount inside the tolerance in force, and the tolerance and the period are declared as package values and reference data, never as schema defaults (DP-06, DP-07)

  Scenario: AC12 The decision record is declared as written before the rows change, and a failed write changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision-record element of the baseline
    When it is compared with DP-03, TSD S7 T2 and legacy RWB-E6-023 AC1 and AC4
    Then the record is declared as an element written before the rows change through the local library on the shared topic, and a failed write declares that no row changes

  Scenario: AC13 The case, its route state and the timer row are declared as rwb-case's and read only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consumed case rows of the baseline
    When they are compared with the Context pack ownership rows, the legacy Data table and ASM-5087
    Then the state read and the move answer are declared as consumed, and the document declares no recovery_case property and no timer property

  Scenario: AC14 The rule package and the ledger are declared as rwb-decision's and read only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consumed package row of the baseline
    When it is compared with Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 and ASM-5086
    Then the contract names R-WO-13, R-WO-15, R-WO-42 and R-WO-43 as consumed, and declares no rule row and no ledger entry

  Scenario: AC15 No published event belongs to this step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the event section of the baseline
    When it is compared with Event and Messaging Design v5 EV-24 and the connection-matrix row of S7
    Then the document declares no producer, names WriteOffApproved (EV-24) as the approval story's, and records the consumed product-ready event of P1 with its placeholder name (ASM-5084, ASM-5088)

  Scenario: AC16 No Schedule belongs to this step (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the scheduling section of the baseline
    When it is compared with Batch and Scheduling Design v5 and ASM-5084
    Then the document declares no Schedule, records that the monthly write-off scan is RWB-S7-E6013-APP's, and records that the period arrives with the product

  Scenario: AC17 The WRITEOFF state vocabulary is closed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the state section of the baseline
    When it is compared with TSD S7 T3.0 and T4 and with RWB-S7-E6017-CON
    Then the WRITEOFF values are declared as an enumeration of state, this step writes three of them, and no state value is declared as a constant of the code (ASM-5087)

  Scenario: AC18 No personal data appears in a schema, an example or a fake (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the schemas, examples and fakes of the baseline
    When each is reviewed against Template and Rules v1 §R7.2
    Then each carries identifiers, amounts, a code and a rule version only, and the populations are compared by reference, never by party

  Scenario: AC19 One REST base, one topic, one queue and one login per service (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the naming section of the baseline
    When it is compared with DP-13 and Template and Rules v1 §R4
    Then the document declares one base, one topic, one queue and one login for rwb-writeoff and declares no base, topic or view of another service as its own
